sentences.en: This Spanish fortress was converted into a beautiful holy shrine.
sentences.zh: 这座西班牙要塞被改造成了一座美丽的圣殿。

sentences.en: My book became the Holy writ for all those engineers.
sentences.zh: 我的书成了所有工程师心中的圣经。

sentences.en: The crucifixion is an important part of the Holy Bible.
sentences.zh: 钉十字架是《圣经》中重要的一部分。

senses.zh: 圣洁的，神圣的；至善的,（俚）太棒了
